description: Undo/redo history for a single diagram editor instance. Not a DI service. TmDiagramEditor creates one instance and cascades it to child components via CascadingValue. Each editor on the page gets its own isolated stack.

members.name: BeginTransaction
members.description: Begins a new transactional scope. Nested transactions are not allowed.

members.name: CommitTransaction
members.description: Commits the current transaction as a single undo/redo step.

members.name: RollbackTransaction
members.description: Rolls back the current transaction without recording it.

members.name: TransactionScope
members.description: Returns an IDisposable wrapper that begins and commits/rolls back a transaction.
